angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 879,365 km at 129.18 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.7410 +/- 0.0133 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 129.18 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.264 +/- 0.033 solar radii from Armstrong et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1052 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.5804A/abstract): 879,365 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.204 +/- 0.025 solar masses from Armstrong et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1052 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.5804A/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6146 +/- 62 K from Armstrong et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1052 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.5804A/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Armstrong et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1052 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.5804A/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1052.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.315, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1052 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.14 dex, from Armstrong et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.5804A/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1052 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.38373, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1052 (pscomppars): age 2.3 Gyr, from Armstrong et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.5804A/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1052 (pscomppars): rotation period 12.8 d, from Armstrong et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.5804A/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1052 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 5 km/s, from Armstrong et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.5804A/abstract)
